relationships.evidence: The federal download page states that ÖKOBAUDAT uses ILCD+EPD and publishes matching developer and validation resources.
relationships.constraints: Profiles and maintenance releases must match.

relationships.evidence: ÖKOBAUDAT admission principles and validation profiles require EN 15804-aligned EPD data.
relationships.constraints: National profile requirements extend the standard.
relationships.validation_question: Separate standard conformance from ÖKOBAUDAT-specific admission rules.

relationships.evidence: The repository states that PMF factors were applied in the BBSR project on raw-material effort in ÖKOBAUDAT.
relationships.constraints: The PMF factors are not automatically embedded in every ÖKOBAUDAT release.
relationships.validation_question: Record the specific dataset and factor versions used.
